card.name: Space before a number in dosing text
card.fires_on: The blank space (or a digit's first character) right before a number in drug-label text. Typical spots are dose amounts, intervals like 'every 3 weeks', and section references such as '12.4'.

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: A space just before a numbered label section cross-reference.

modes.label: Space before dose or interval number
modes.description: A space before a dose amount or a number of weeks in a dosing regimen.
